possible_cause: Model service latency or overloaded inference endpoint
resolution: Verify model service availability and review request timeout and retry configuration

possible_cause: Invalid input or embedding service unavailable
resolution: Validate the input and verify embedding service configuration and availability

possible_cause: Database connection failure or incorrect collection/index configuration
resolution: Verify vector database connectivity and confirm the collection and index configuration

possible_cause: Missing variables or incorrectly formatted prompt template
resolution: Validate prompt variables and verify the prompt template configuration

possible_cause: Incorrect endpoint configuration or backend service unavailable
resolution: Verify the API endpoint configuration and check backend service availability

possible_cause: Invalid query or database connection problem
resolution: Validate the query and verify database connectivity and credentials

possible_cause: Expired token or invalid authentication credentials
resolution: Verify token validity and refresh authentication credentials when required

possible_cause: Queue connection failure or malformed message payload
resolution: Verify queue connectivity and validate the message payload
